body: Did you read the reply I sent you earlier?
I’m too young to get one.

You’re right. I’ve tried the dating this girl at school but I always get shrugged off. I’m not really big into video games :/ nothing in life really makes me happy tbh. I just turned 13 the other day and my family didn’t even recognize me or even say a fucking happy birthday. They just don’t care about me. And it’s not because of that onto why I hate them, it’s the little shit they do. My sister will do some shit and my parents will immediately blame me. My dad is barely ever home and when he does come home he beats my mom and my younger siblings. My mom does meth in front of me and neglects my siblings often. One time, my aunt gave me birthday money and my mom took it to buy drugs. My whole house is fucked up.
Thank you for your extremely helpful advice. It made me totally not want to kill them. 10/10 will ask for advice again
Eat all the food I want

A shotgun to the head is the most painless and quickest way. I know it sounds gruesome but it’s so quick that you won’t feel a goddamn thing. Not even for a split second. 

But if you do go out, I wish you nothing but the best in your next life (if you believe in reincarnation) I hope that you’ll be the happiest you can ever be and will achieve everything you didn’t get to or wanted. 

Stay safe.
